Tradenest Naturals: Your Ashok Chaal Powder Exporter

Ashok chaal powder is made from the dried stem bark of Saraca asoca. Tradenest Naturals is an ashok chaal powder exporter supplying herbal brands, supplement makers and distributors worldwide. We clean, dehydrate and mill the bark into a fine, reddish-brown powder. Each lot is checked for colour, texture and moisture, so you get consistent material from order to order. Herbal companies use it as a raw material for traditional Ayurvedic formulations.

Understanding Bulk Ashoka Bark Powder

Our bulk ashok chaal powder supplier work starts with responsible sourcing. Raw bark is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers and collectors in India. We then clean, dehydrate and mill the material under hygienic conditions. A final sieving step gives an even particle size. The result is a stable, easy-to-handle powder for a range of commercial uses.

Key Specifications of Our Herbal Powder

Clear specifications make purchasing simple. Our standard saraca asoca bark powder manufacturer grade is milled to 80-100 mesh. Moisture is kept below 10% to help prevent caking in storage. The powder is plain bark with no added colours, fillers or dyes. Shelf life is 24 months in cool, dry storage. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation.

Applications and Industry Uses

Our ashok chaal powder price is set for buyers who order in bulk. Ayurvedic, supplement and herbal brands all use this ingredient. It is a traditional ingredient in classic Ayurvedic preparations for women, and it is also used in capsules and herbal teas. Some cosmetic brands also use it in herbal skin care. Demand is steady among international ashok bark powder bulk buyer networks.

Processing and Quality Practices

At Tradenest Naturals, we pair traditional herbal knowledge with modern processing. We use pulverizers and sieving machines for an even particle size. Our team follows food hygiene practices under our FSSAI licence. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. We keep batch records for every lot, so you can trace your order. That is why buyers looking for reliable ashok chaal powder india supply choose to work with us.

Packaging Options and Export Support

Shipping overseas calls for sturdy packing. We use export-grade packing that protects the powder from moisture, light and contamination. Options include multi-wall paper bags, HDPE drums and private label pouches. Each pack is labelled with batch number, packing date and storage instructions. As an IEC registered exporter, we give export documentation support and ship worldwide from India. Contact Tradenest Naturals to discuss your requirements.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is the minimum order quantity for ashok chaal powder exporter?

Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg. This covers trial orders, and we can also plan larger repeat volumes for regular buyers.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

We are an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We offer retail and bulk bags as well as custom private label packs. Stored in cool, dry conditions, the powder has a shelf life of 24 months.

What are the typical specifications for mesh, moisture, and purity?

Our standard powder is dehydrated and milled to 80-100 mesh, with moisture below 10%. It is plain bark powder with no chemical additives.

What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote?

Lead time depends on order volume and packing, and we confirm it on each quotation. You can request a sample or a commercial quote by contacting our export sales team through our website.
